name: Empress Market
tagline: A century-old colonial-era market at the heart of Saddar's daily hustle.
about: Built in the 1880s, Empress Market's clock tower still anchors Saddar. Inside its stone arcades, spice sellers, fruit vendors and vegetable stalls have traded side by side for generations.

name: New Sabzi Mandi
tagline: Karachi's largest wholesale-to-retail produce hub, buzzing from dawn.
about: Trucks from Sindh, Punjab and Balochistan roll in before sunrise, making this the city's primary wholesale hub. Retail shoppers who arrive early get first pick at unbeatable prices.
address: Super Highway (M-9 Motorway), near Sohrab Goth, Karachi

name: Malir Sabzi Mandi
tagline: Riverside stalls known for the freshest greens brought in overnight.
about: Growers from the green belt along the Malir River bring leafy greens and herbs in overnight, so the morning stalls are famously crisp and fragrant.
address: Malir City, near Malir River, Karachi

name: Liaquatabad Sabzi Market
tagline: A neighbourhood favourite for honest prices and friendly regulars.
about: A lively, close-knit market where vendors know regulars by name. Expect fair prices, honest weights and plenty of seasonal variety.

name: Water Pump Sabzi Market
tagline: Compact, well-organised aisles serving Federal B Area's daily kitchens.
about: Tidy, well-lit aisles make Water Pump one of the easiest markets to shop in Federal B Area, with dependable quality for daily kitchen needs.

name: Nazimabad Sabzi Market
tagline: A classic Nazimabad institution, steps away from Bada Maidan.
about: A Nazimabad institution a short walk from Bada Maidan, loved for its mango season displays and generous bunches of fresh herbs.
address: Nazimabad No. 3, near Bada Maidan, Karachi

name: Mawach Goth Sabzi Mandi
tagline: Baldia Town's go-to mandi for bulk buys and unbeatable prices.
about: Baldia Town's biggest mandi, where restaurants and large families come for bulk buys, sacks of onions and potatoes, and rock-bottom rates.
address: Baldia Town, near Hub River Road, Karachi

name: Gulshan-e-Iqbal Sabzi Market
tagline: Two lively blocks of stalls serving Gulshan's biggest neighbourhood.
about: Spread across Block 6 and Block 13-D, this double market serves one of Karachi's largest neighbourhoods with an excellent range of fruit.

name: Orangi Town Sabzi Bazaar
tagline: A community bazaar known for its tight-knit growers and vendors.
about: Run by a tight community of growers and vendors, Orangi's bazaar is known for friendly bargaining and fresh local greens.

name: Korangi No. 4 Market
tagline: A busy crossing-side market serving Korangi's industrial workforce.
about: Right by Korangi Crossing, this busy market keeps long hours for the industrial workforce, with quick turnover that keeps produce fresh.
